subject: Riverbed status: conversion validated, one stateful-layer gotcha
body:
Hi Priya, Alina,

Status. May 29 milestone done: both model families reproduce reference accuracy in non-streaming training mode, and Vera's runs are within 0.1% absolute of the published numbers on the keyword benchmark.

Conversion milestone is effectively done ten days early, with one asterisk. For the convolutional family, streaming inference on 20ms chunks is bit-exact with the non-streaming model over our full internal keyword set. The gotcha is the recurrent family: state resets between utterances weren't handled in our harness (not the release's fault — our bug), which produced a phantom 2% accuracy drop that cost us a week. Fixed; now matching.

Risk for the Jul 24 readout: first numbers off the DSP boards put the conv model at 14ms per 20ms chunk — real-time with margin — but memory on the smallest target board is tight, 480KB against a 512KB budget. If quantization doesn't buy headroom, we may need to drop the largest conv variant from the device matrix.

Linnea
